text:
The central bank's Monetary Policy Rate (MPR) is set at 1.75 percent, after being lowered from 2.0 percent for the second quarter of 2024 and maintained at that level thereafter [C065], [C086]. 

IMF staff assesses the current monetary policy stance as "broadly neutral" and considers it "appropriate" [C024]. Staff recommends a data-dependent approach, noting that the Central Bank of Seychelles (CBS) should be prepared to respond to emerging price pressures if they materialize, whereas further monetary accommodation would be warranted if downside risks in economic activity materialize given the still low level of headline inflation [C024].
